digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation validity and pin enforcement
propositions: Pin drift, missing targets, or malformed pins must invalidate plan-review attestations when enforce_plan_material_pins is enabled, while remaining advisory when disabled.
Derived health must aggregate target pin statuses by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and support legacy-unpinned semantics for wholly unpinned attestations.
Optional configuration enforce_plan_material_pins must fail open (return false) with structured warning on read errors, blocking enforcement only when explicitly enabled and readable.
Reviewed related material must be persisted in plan_review_result_v2 sidecars during LLM review and validated during re-sign recovery without requiring a certified attestation.
drift_refresh_candidate must invoke compute_validity with DRIFT_REFRESH profile, delegating signature/kind/reopen/registry/own-material/pin checks and retaining only code-drift qualification inline.

Pin health must be derived after signature and kind validation but before existing early returns in compute_validity, exposing simultaneous pin drift even when cheaper checks control the top-level verdict.
